title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers and a target value, find two indices whose values add up to the target.
approach: Use a hash map to store previously seen values and their indices. For each number, check whether target minus the current number already exists.

title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted array and a target value, find the index of the target.
approach: Use low and high pointers. Check the middle element and eliminate half of the search space after each comparison.

title: Reverse Linked List
description: Reverse a singly linked list and return the new head.
approach: Maintain previous and current pointers and reverse each next pointer while traversing the list.
